item.title: Israel bars U.S. citizens over criticism and ties to Palestinian activists, lawyers say
item.description: Travelers from the U.S. and other nations are denied entry to Israel after interrogations about their links to Palestinians, plans to visit the occupied West Bank and opinions of Israel, lawyers say.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Germany blames Russia for last month's attempted drone attack at Leipzig airport
item.description: The German government blamed Russia for an attempted attack at Leipzig airport last month using a drone laden with explosives. It announced that it would shut down a Russian consulate among measures.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Putin signals support for Iran in ongoing war with the U.S.
item.description: Russia's Vladimir Putin is signaling unwavering support for Iran, as Tehran thanks Moscow for backing amid the escalating Middle East war.

item.title: U.S. military strikes Iran, while Trump vows more for Tehran's retaliation
item.description: The U.S. military hit targets in Iran on Tuesday and Tehran fired missiles and drones at various sites across the region in response as hostilities flare once again in an intermittent war.

item.title: A week after the deadly floods in Nepal, rescuers work to find survivors
item.description: Nearly a week after flash floods devastated parts of Nepal and Tibet, rescuers are still searching for people trapped in hydropower plants. But first they have to find the plants.

item.title: Global finance ministers gather in North Carolina for G20 summit
item.description: The U.S. is playing host to finance ministers from around the world this week. Russia's top economic official made a stir on Monday when he showed up in person at the meeting in North Carolina.
